translations.web: Fraudulent food is sweet to a man, but afterwards his mouth is filled with gravel.
translations.bsb: Food gained by fraud is sweet to a man, but later his mouth is full of gravel.
translations.kjv: Bread of deceit is sweet to a man; but afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel.
translations.asv: Bread of falsehood is sweet to a man; But afterwards his mouth shall be filled with gravel.
